:::{#def-minimum}
#### Minimum

Let $A \subseteq \reals$.
A number $m$ is the **minimum** of $A$,
written $\min A$,
if $m \in A$ and $m \le a$ for all $a \in A$.

:::

::: notes
Not every set has a minimum.
The interval $(0, 1]$ has none:
every element $a$ of it has a smaller element, $a/2$, also in it.
In @exr-min-and-argmin,
the smallest value of $g$ is $\min\cb{5, 2, 2, 5} = 2$.
:::
